speaker: NIS Cooperation Group, EU work stream on post-quantum cryptography
verbatim: In particular, it is recommended that all Member States initiate a national PQC transition strategy following First Steps by the end of 2026 and coordinate their efforts at the EU level.
headline: The EU's NIS Cooperation Group set the end of 2026 for every Member State to have started a national post-quantum transition.
resolution_criteria: Resolves VERIFIED if, by 31 Dec 2026, all 27 Member States have initiated a national PQC transition strategy following the roadmap's First Steps, as reported by the NIS Cooperation Group, the European Commission or ENISA, or shown by each state's published plan. The grace period is 90 days because status reporting lags the deadline. PARTIALLY_VERIFIED if a majority but not all have. NOT_VERIFIED if fewer than half have, or if no status is published by the end of the grace period.
resolver_sources: National cybersecurity agencies' PQC roadmaps (for example ANSSI, BSI, NCSC-NL)
